facts.text: GAME ONE ON THE RADIO AT NOON
facts.why: The sources I opened say John recounts Game One of the 1969 World Series to Frank, but none give a start time.
facts.fix: GAME ONE ON THE RADIO IN THE AFTERNOON

vibe.verdict: A warm Queens firehouse supper that gets the Mets, the radio, Julia and Little Chief right.
missing: The ham radio and the aurora night (how John reaches Frank)
Frank quitting cigarettes (the 1989 lung cancer warning)
Game 5 and the shoe polish play (Frank proves himself to Satch)
'Don't follow your instincts, go the other way' (the warning that saves Frank)
Satch DeLeon as the friend at the table (arrest scene)
The baseball and the Nightingale case board (John's cold case)
ideas: Swap the 'Transistor Radio' raffle prize for a 'Ham Radio', with 'Over and out' on the ticket.
Swap 'Hot Cocoa' for 'Frank's Last Cigarette, a chocolate cigar', a nod to him quitting.
Add a Mets pennant corner to the firehouse photo header in place of the plain brick bar.
Swap the 'Coffee' note 'all game long' for 'all game long, and a call from 1999'.
